name: 🍅 Ratatouille
what: Whatever veggies we have, roasted until sweet, then stirred into a tomato sauce.

core.name: 4–5 vegetables: eggplant, zucchini, squash, peppers
core.out: any mix works: mushrooms, onion, broccoli, carrots

core.name: Canned diced tomatoes (big can)
core.out: 5–6 fresh tomatoes, or a jar of marinara

core.name: Onion + garlic
core.out: skip the onion, or use garlic powder

extras: parmesan, crusty bread, Italian seasoning, pasta or rice to serve it over

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter. Oven to 425°F.
Cut the veggies into bite-size cubes, all about the same size. Toss with oil and salt on two pans.
Roast, stirring once halfway, until the edges are brown.
While they roast: soften a chopped onion in oil in a pot, add garlic, then the tomatoes. Simmer.
Stir the roasted veggies into the sauce. Taste, add salt. Serve with cheese and bread.

key: Two pans, not one. Crowded veggies steam and go mushy.
done: Veggies are soft with brown edges.
plan_b: Short on time? Skip the oven: cook everything in the pot, 20 minutes, and serve it over pasta.
